mechanics.name: Appraisal
mechanics.currentEffect: Start the Trial with 4 Tokens. Rummaging through an already opened Chest consumes 1 Token and retrieves an additional Item. Each Chest can be rummaged up to twice. You rummage 40/60/80% faster.
activation: Have a Token and rummage through an already opened Chest.
Ends/deactivates when: Cannot be used after all Tokens are spent.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.1.0): Updated Appraisal to allow two rummages per Chest and added tiered rummage-speed values.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Spend up to four tokens to retrieve extra Items from already opened Chests.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Starts with 4 Tokens; each rummage consumes 1; maximum two rummages per Chest.
specialInteractions: A Chest must already have been opened.

editorial.summary: Start with four Tokens and rummage opened Chests for extra Items up to four times, at greatly increased rummage speed.
useCases: Turn already-opened Chests into additional Items.
Feed chest-based perks that care about repeated searches or Item supply.
Create more team resources without bringing four Items from the lobby.
counters: The extra Item is still random.
Four Tokens cap the total value.
pros: Four extra Item rolls is substantial resource volume.
Up to 80% faster rummaging reduces the side-objective tax.
Each Chest can support two rummages.
cons: Often weaker than bringing the desired Item directly.
analysis: Appraisal is a resource-generation perk rather than a direct match-speed perk. Four Tokens means four additional Item rolls from Chests that were already opened, which can create a surprising amount of total equipment.
The 80% rummage-speed bonus makes the interaction less painful, and modern chest builds can combine Appraisal with Plunderer’s Instinct, Pharmacy, Ace in the Hole, or Moment of Glory.
The opportunity cost remains travel and randomness. A Survivor who crosses the map to rummage for an Item they never needed may lose more generator time than the resource can repay.
Appraisal is therefore a legitimate chest-build engine and a poor blind general slot. Its ranking should be judged alongside the entire loot package rather than in isolation.
editorial.verdict: The engine room of chest builds: lots of extra Items, little certainty that those Items were worth the detour.
